in_hindi.name: पूर्णा
in_hindi.long_meaning: पूर्णता (पूरा होना, पूरा होकर, साफ रहना) (Fullness, Wholeness, Completion)

in_marathi.name: Purna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Purna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Purna’, which means ‘complete’, ‘perfect’ or ‘whole’. This name is given to babies born with a sense of completeness, who are believed to be perfect in every way.
